checks.name: Registration/login remain functional and password whitespace is preserved
NoSQL operator objects cannot authenticate or create accounts
UTF-8 passwords exceeding bcrypt byte limits are rejected over HTTP
Room names are normalized before storage and duplicate/invalid names are rejected
Socket message length and recipient rules are enforced
Sanitized text is persisted and valid emoji remain intact
Two real browsers render script and event-handler payloads as literal text without executing them
Stored message history remains safely rendered after reload
The browser shows a near-limit counter and caps messages at 2000 characters
Browser room-name constraints accept valid names and reject HTML without runtime errors
